chunks: Until the certainty (of death) had come upon us.

key_terms.الْيَقِينُ: Certainty, specifically referring to the reality of death and the Hereafter.

ai.seo_question: What is meant by 'al-Yaqin' (the Certainty) in the context of death in Shia theology?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'al-Yaqin' (the Certainty) in Surah Al-Muddaththir is interpreted not merely as the physical end of life, but as the unveiling of the unseen reality (al-Ghayb) that was previously hidden from the soul's perception. This moment marks the transition from the realm of doubt and potential to the absolute truth of divine judgment, echoing the Quranic promise that 'knowledge of the Hour is with my Lord only' (74:15).
